_review_notes.scope: Applies to AY 2026-27 (FY 2025-26) -- the year this project's Form16/Form26AS/ITR-1 pipeline targets. Governed by the Income Tax Act, 1961, NOT the Income Tax Act, 2025 (which only applies to Tax Year 2026-27 onward, i.e. income earned April 2026-March 2027, filed July 2027).
_review_notes.why_section_numbers_changed_from_origina: The original final_tax_act.json used Income Tax Act 2025 section numbers (123, 124, 131, 132, 153). Those govern a LATER filing cycle than this project processes. Section numbers below use the 1961 Act (80C, 24(b), etc.), which is what actually applies to the AY 2026-27 returns this system generates.
